issues.body: In split_blocks, any line matching BEGIN_INJECT_RE sets in_inject=True, and EOF while in_inject is accepted. Every subsequent line is discarded, so adding `<!-- BEGIN-INJECT -->` without a matching end marker can hide arbitrary hand-copied content from the hard exact-duplication gate. The regex also accepts loose marker shapes rather than the documented `<!-- BEGIN-INJECT: … -->` form. The self-test covers only a well-balanced region, so it does not exercise the fail-closed invariant.
issues.fix_hint: Parse strict BEGIN/END marker lines, track the opening line, and report malformed, nested, unmatched-END, and unterminated-BEGIN regions as gating findings/errors. Add hermetic self-tests proving each malformed delimiter case returns failure, especially a planted duplicate after an unterminated BEGIN marker.
issues.title: Unterminated BEGIN-INJECT silently exempts the rest of a document

verdict.summary: The two-tier duplication checker is well structured and its ordinary duplicate, link-normalization, fence, allowlist, and advisory behaviors have meaningful self-tests. However, the new gating checker can be bypassed by a malformed or unterminated BEGIN-INJECT marker: split_blocks enters injection mode and silently discards the rest of the file without validating that a matching END-INJECT exists. Because injected regions are an explicit exclusion from the scanned surface, malformed delimiters must fail closed before this becomes a hard CI gate.
